title: Handling GST Summons under Section 70: Rights, Procedural Defense & Compliance
summary: Practical guidelines when receiving inquiry summons or DRC-01 show cause notices from DGGI.
body:
A summons under Section 70 of the CGST Act is a judicial inquiry proceeding. Non-appearance or furnishing false records can invite prosecution.

If you have received a departmental summons or DRC-01 show cause notice, [book an urgent consultation](/schedule) immediately.

Substantiating genuine movement of goods via weighbridge slips and e-way bills is critical. You can [schedule a consultation](/schedule) with our statutory counsel prior to your hearing.
